title: Works But Not Amazing
text: Works But Not Amazing. This does what it says but can be messy and I feel like uses a lot of oil and the brush doesn't always sit flush so you have to work at the suction in order to get the oil in the brush at times so I use it but I don't think I'd buy it again if I had a do over.

product_metadata.title: Topcci Oil Dispenser with Brush, 2 in 1 Glass Olive Oil Dispenser Bottle with Silicone Brush, Dropper Measuring Cooking Oil Dispenser Bottle Container for Kitchen Baking BBQ Grill Air Fryer ( Blue )
features: [ Unique 2 in 1 Design ] : Novel 2 in 1 oil dispenser bottle with silicone oil brush and dripper are made of food-grade PP which makes oil sprayed and brushed ,easy, convenient. The three-layer silicone soft oil bottle brush with completely BPA free and Eco-friendly, no odor, no deformation, no lint. Besides, the scaled oil storage bottle can make you apply oil quantitative and controllable as well.

[ Easy to Use ] : We just need to squeeze the silicone dripper gently to basting oil on the pan or grilling food after filling oil from the wide mouth of the glass olive oil bottle dispenser, can control the oil absorption and oil spray, which is very convenient and practical,you have no more worry about wasting oil and getting dirty any more.

[ Easy to Clean ] : The glass olive oil dispenser with brush comes with PP filter funnel,and each part can be disassembled and cleaned separately with clean water, also effectively preventing the growth of bacteria.

[ Widely Application ] : According to your daily requirements, you can pour olive oils, sauce, vinegar, honey, butter, lemon juice or wine into the kitchen oil dispenser bottle and oil brush for cooking, outdoor barbecue, turkey, cake, salad making, baking, roasting, grilling, frying ,party dinner and so on. which can satisfy indoor needs in kitchen and outdoor barbecue. Just enjoy your healthy life with oil bottle dispenser.

[ Package included ] : You will get the 1 cooking oil dispenser in blue (which is consist of silicone dripper(kitchen oil dropper), AS transparent oil storage with measurement scales,T shape silicone brush, PP filter funnel, PE straw and glass bottle.Hope you will enjoy the cooking oil bottle .
